pages.title: Outer Sea Public Stall
pages.text: The stall follows merchant_shops.json#outer_sea_public_stall and region_cards/outer_sea_market.json. It uses the existing market system without adding a dedicated vendor NPC, pearl-tax UI, or extra loader, and trades in low-grade metal spirit stones.

pages.title: Current Stock
pages.text: Current stock now includes spirit_stone_shard, pearl_raw, and herb_bundle_low. One low-grade metal spirit stone buys 10 shards, stock 999; Raw Sea Pearl costs 8 low-grade metal spirit stones, stock 50; the herb bundle grants 4 Spirit Grass for 12, stock 30. All refresh every 24000 ticks.

pages.title: Planned Content
pages.text: Pearl taxes, stall rules, ferry tasks, and tax-ticket quests still need economy loops plus merchant or quest presentation. Raw Sea Pearl is currently an item and stall good only; refined coral pearls, reverse exchange, and pearl-specific economy UI remain deferred.
